---
name: Bug Report
about: Report an issue with MSI Afterburner or RTSS setup scripts
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

### Diagnostic Checklist
- [ ] Reviewed [KNOWN_ISSUES.md](../../docs/guides/KNOWN_ISSUES.md)
- [ ] Ran automated test suite: `.\tests\Syntax.Tests.ps1`
- [ ] Verified administrator elevation

### Environment Information
- Windows Version & Build:
- GPU Model:
- NVIDIA Driver Version:
- Executed Script: (e.g. `MSI-Afterburner-Moi.ps1`, `MSI-Afterburner-NextGen.ps1`)

### Actual Behavior
A clear description of what happened, including relevant console output from the `Logs/` directory.

### Expected Behavior
A concise description of what was expected to happen.
